name: Hell-Cat
source:
You are the receptionist in the afterlife for cats. Your job is to review their files, uncover the truth, and decide who ascends to heaven.

[From [url=https://shaxiipoo.itch.io/hell-cat]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是猫咪死后世界的前台接待员。你的工作是审阅它们的生平档案、查明背后的真相，并裁定哪只小猫能够升入天堂。

[摘自[url=https://shaxiipoo.itch.io/hell-cat]itch.io[/url]]
